_metadata.paper: TOP, NeurIPS 2023; supplementary Figure 1 displays 6 examples from this released 26-prototype code bank
_metadata.template: an H&E stained image of {tissue}, which is {description}
_metadata.task_scope: task-agnostic; used by the released TCGA-NSCLC and CAMELYON recipes
_metadata.slot_separator_note: The empty default matches train_TCGAFeat_MIL_CLIP.py; the CAMELYON protocol overrides it with one space to match train_CAMELYONFeat_MIL_CLIP.py.

prototypes.description: Flat, plate-like cells with a centrally located nucleus.
prototypes.prompt: an H&E stained image of Squamous epithelium, which is Flat, plate-like cells with a centrally located nucleus.

prototypes.description: Elongated cells with a basally located, oval-shaped nucleus.
prototypes.prompt: an H&E stained image of Columnar epithelium, which is Elongated cells with a basally located, oval-shaped nucleus.

prototypes.description: Cells organized in gland-like structures, secreting various substances.
prototypes.prompt: an H&E stained image of Glandular epithelium, which is Cells organized in gland-like structures, secreting various substances.

prototypes.description: Large, round cells with a thin rim of cytoplasm and a peripheral nucleus, filled with a lipid droplet.
prototypes.prompt: an H&E stained image of Adipose tissue, which is Large, round cells with a thin rim of cytoplasm and a peripheral nucleus, filled with a lipid droplet.

prototypes.description: Dense arrangement of collagen fibers and fibroblast cells with elongated nuclei.
prototypes.prompt: an H&E stained image of Fibrous connective tissue, which is Dense arrangement of collagen fibers and fibroblast cells with elongated nuclei.

prototypes.description: Chondrocytes embedded in a matrix with a basophilic appearance, arranged in lacunae.
prototypes.prompt: an H&E stained image of Cartilage, which is Chondrocytes embedded in a matrix with a basophilic appearance, arranged in lacunae.

prototypes.description: Calcified matrix with embedded osteocytes in lacunae, connected by canaliculi.
prototypes.prompt: an H&E stained image of Bone tissue, which is Calcified matrix with embedded osteocytes in lacunae, connected by canaliculi.

prototypes.description: Long, cylindrical, multinucleated cells with visible striations.
prototypes.prompt: an H&E stained image of Skeletal muscle, which is Long, cylindrical, multinucleated cells with visible striations.

prototypes.description: Spindle-shaped cells with a single, centrally located nucleus and no visible striations.
prototypes.prompt: an H&E stained image of Smooth muscle, which is Spindle-shaped cells with a single, centrally located nucleus and no visible striations.

prototypes.description: Branching, striated cells with a single, centrally located nucleus and intercalated discs between cells.
prototypes.prompt: an H&E stained image of Cardiac muscle, which is Branching, striated cells with a single, centrally located nucleus and intercalated discs between cells.

prototypes.description: Large, star-shaped cells with a prominent, round nucleus and several processes extending from the cell body.
prototypes.prompt: an H&E stained image of Neurons, which is Large, star-shaped cells with a prominent, round nucleus and several processes extending from the cell body.

prototypes.description: Smaller, supportive cells with a less-defined shape and a small, dark nucleus.
prototypes.prompt: an H&E stained image of Glial cells, which is Smaller, supportive cells with a less-defined shape and a small, dark nucleus.

prototypes.description: Small, round cells with a large, dark nucleus and a thin rim of cytoplasm.
prototypes.prompt: an H&E stained image of Lymphocytes, which is Small, round cells with a large, dark nucleus and a thin rim of cytoplasm.

prototypes.description: Areas of active lymphocyte proliferation and differentiation, appearing as lighter-stained regions in lymphoid tissue.
prototypes.prompt: an H&E stained image of Germinal centers, which is Areas of active lymphocyte proliferation and differentiation, appearing as lighter-stained regions in lymphoid tissue.

prototypes.description: Anucleate, biconcave, disc-shaped cells.
prototypes.prompt: an H&E stained image of Erythrocytes, which is Anucleate, biconcave, disc-shaped cells.

prototypes.description: Nucleated white blood cells with various morphologies, including neutrophils, lymphocytes, and monocytes.
prototypes.prompt: an H&E stained image of Leukocytes, which is Nucleated white blood cells with various morphologies, including neutrophils, lymphocytes, and monocytes.

prototypes.description: Large, polygonal cells with a round, centrally located nucleus and abundant cytoplasm.
prototypes.prompt: an H&E stained image of Hepatocytes, which is Large, polygonal cells with a round, centrally located nucleus and abundant cytoplasm.

prototypes.description: Vascular channels between hepatocytes, lined by endothelial cells and Kupffer cells in liver tissue.
prototypes.prompt: an H&E stained image of Sinusoids, which is Vascular channels between hepatocytes, lined by endothelial cells and Kupffer cells in liver tissue.

prototypes.description: Compact, round structures composed of capillaries and specialized cells with a visible Bowman's space in kidney tissue.
prototypes.prompt: an H&E stained image of Glomeruli, which is Compact, round structures composed of capillaries and specialized cells with a visible Bowman's space in kidney tissue.

prototypes.description: Epithelial-lined structures with various cell types, including proximal and distal tubule cells in kidney tissue.
prototypes.prompt: an H&E stained image of Tubules, which is Epithelial-lined structures with various cell types, including proximal and distal tubule cells in kidney tissue.

prototypes.description: Disorganized tissue architecture, cellular atypia, and possible invasion into surrounding tissues in epithelial-derived tissues.
prototypes.prompt: an H&E stained image of Carcinoma, which is Disorganized tissue architecture, cellular atypia, and possible invasion into surrounding tissues in epithelial-derived tissues.

prototypes.description: Pleomorphic cells, high cellularity, and possible invasion into surrounding tissues in mesenchymal-derived tissues.
prototypes.prompt: an H&E stained image of Sarcoma, which is Pleomorphic cells, high cellularity, and possible invasion into surrounding tissues in mesenchymal-derived tissues.

prototypes.description: Atypical lymphocytes, disrupted lymphoid architecture, and possible effacement of normal lymphoid structures.
prototypes.prompt: an H&E stained image of Lymphoma, which is Atypical lymphocytes, disrupted lymphoid architecture, and possible effacement of normal lymphoid structures.

prototypes.description: Increased number of abnormal white blood cells in blood smears or bone marrow aspirates, with variable size and nuclear morphology.
prototypes.prompt: an H&E stained image of Leukemia, which is Increased number of abnormal white blood cells in blood smears or bone marrow aspirates, with variable size and nuclear morphology.

prototypes.description: Atypical glial cells, increased cellularity, possible necrosis, and disruption of normal central nervous system tissue architecture.
prototypes.prompt: an H&E stained image of Glioma, which is Atypical glial cells, increased cellularity, possible necrosis, and disruption of normal central nervous system tissue architecture.

prototypes.description: Atypical melanocytes with variable size, shape, and pigmentation, cellular atypia, and invasion of surrounding tissues.
prototypes.prompt: an H&E stained image of Melanoma, which is Atypical melanocytes with variable size, shape, and pigmentation, cellular atypia, and invasion of surrounding tissues.
